subject: Steering committee: scheduling + prep for Redwood pilot

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@fintegrate.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Steering committee: scheduling + prep for Redwood pilot

Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your executive steering committee lined up: 

1) Recap (from our discovery):
- Primary use case: customer support deflection + routing for payments ops (short-term) with embeddings for KB search (phase 2).
- Key decision criteria: latency (p95 < 350ms for priority routes), cost per 1M tokens, and security controls (audit logs + VPC).
- Procurement/process notes: requires legal & procurement review + SOC2 attestation; finance needs an SOW for budget approval.

2) Proposed steering committee attendees (from our side / ask):
- Economic buyer: Carlos Mendes (VP of Product) — owns budget and timeline.
- Technical sponsor: Sofia Alvarez (Head of Platform).
- Security/Compliance: can be a short review by your security team (SOC2 evidence & KMS requirements).
- Ops/Support: contact who will own runbooks.

3) Next steps we suggest:
- Schedule a 45-minute steering committee meeting week of Aug 2 — goal: align scope, timeline (pilot MVP = 8 weeks), procurement steps.
- We will share a 1-page pilot SOW + technical appendix and a draft agenda before the meeting.

Attached: draft steering committee agenda + .ics for quick calendar share.

Can you confirm who will be the economic buyer and legal/procurement contacts? Also please suggest 2-3 times that week that work for Carlos + Sofia.

Thanks — happy to keep this tight and actionable.


Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0172
redwood.inference

Vivek — can you join the call as the AE lead for exec-level questions and to cover procurement/commercial cadence (we may need a 1-page SOW for finance).

Carlos/Alex — I'll circulate the final agenda + pilot SOW by EOD Mon Aug 2. Anything you want on the agenda specifically (besides rollout metrics/rollback criteria)?

All — thanks for coordinating. A couple of quick notes from my side before the steering committee: 

- Agenda: I'll lead the commercial section (~10 min) and include the proposed pilot milestone plan and acceptance criteria (success metrics + rollback triggers). Marissa — send me the SOW draft and I will pull the pricing examples into the one-pager we share with finance.
- Security/procurement asks: we should be prepared with (a) SOC2 type II report link, (b) an outline of data residency + retention options, and (c) a draft security questionnaire response for Priya. Dev — can you gather the SOC2 link and a short KMS notes doc (one page) by EOD Mon Aug 2?
- Contract cadence: propose 2-week procurement review once security gives the OK; finance sign-off usually aligns with that window. If legal wants an NDA addendum or updated DPA we should expect iterative redlines.

I'll join the Wed Aug 4 13:00 PT call.
